needs_a_hand_check.note: The RBNZ Annual Report 2025 PDF returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch reports a client error on it, so the financial statements could not be read. The RBNZ page 'How we manage foreign reserves' describes the reserves as mainly government bonds plus a small holding in BIS investment funds (Asian Bond Fund, Chinese Yuan Bond Fund, US Dollar Green Bond Fund) and says nothing about gold either way. Needs a hand check of the annual report PDF.

Reserve Bank of Malawi: the Financial Statements listing page loads its document links by script (no PDF hrefs in the markup), one fetch of it returned a connection reset, and WebFetch is refused by the site's robots.txt. A scribd copy of 'RBM Financial Statement 31 December 2024' appeared in search but is a third-party mirror, so it was not used. Malawi is the most likely remaining record on this row: it ran a domestic gold purchase programme and reversed it in 2026, so the financial statements should say where the gold sits. Needs a hand check.

Banque Centrale de Mauritanie: the only annual-report PDF a search surfaced downloads as 2,568 bytes (truncated or a placeholder), and bcm.mr's home page serves no report links in its markup for either curl or WebFetch. Needs a hand check.

Palestine Monetary Authority: the annual-report PDF path returned by search gives HTTP 404 (9-byte body), and no other PMA annual report or financial statements PDF was found. Needs a hand check of pma.ps/en/Publications/AnnualReports.
Bank of the Lao PDR Annual Economic Report 2023: curl fails on an incomplete TLS chain at bol.gov.la and WebFetch is refused by the site's robots.txt. Needs a hand check.

Banco Central de Timor-Leste: the BCTL Annual Report 2020 URL returns an HTML page rather than the PDF. The Timor-Leste Petroleum Fund Annual Report 2022 (https://www.bancocentral.tl/media/krep/None/f401308c88f04038a4ebef3641d13677.pdf) was read in full, 220,846 characters, and contains no gold at all -- but that is the Petroleum Fund, not the BCTL's own reserves, so it does not close the country. Needs a hand check of the BCTL annual report.

Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador audited financial statements: two transparencia.gob.sv document-download URLs returned no usable PDF. The BCR bought gold for the first time since 1990 in 2025, so its 2025 statements are a live lead for a custodian. Needs a hand check.

Bank of Tanzania Note 20 also records TZS 1,517,580.5 million of gold 'held at the Bank of Tanzania pending transfer to the foreign custodian' at 30 June 2025 -- a self-custody holding, but the note names no vault or city, so this row's rule bars it.
